scripts.build:ui: npx esbuild src/scripts/canvas-runner.ts --outfile=src/scripts/canvas-runner.js --format=iife && vite build && powershell -Command "New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path 'zig-out\bin\dist' | Out-Null; Copy-Item -Recurse -Force 'dist\*' 'zig-out\bin\dist\'; Copy-Item -Force 'WebView2Loader.dll' 'zig-out\bin\'"
scripts.build:zig: powershell -Command "try { Stop-Process -Name contentgen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; zig build"
scripts.build:zig:release: powershell -Command "try { Stop-Process -Name contentgen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } catch {}; zig build -Doptimize=ReleaseFast"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:ui && npm run build:zig
scripts.build:release: npm run build:ui && npm run build:zig:release
